title: Commerce adds export controls on advanced computing chips and semiconductor manufacturing items destined for China
abstract: The Bureau of Industry and Security imposes license requirements on exports of advanced integrated circuits, computers containing them, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China.

title: Proclamation adjusting imports of steel and aluminum into the United States
abstract: Raises Section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum imports and removes country exemptions.

title: Additional Section 301 tariffs on products of China
abstract: The U.S. Trade Representative raises duties on a list of consumer and industrial goods imported from China.

title: Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: selected drugs and negotiated prices
abstract: CMS publishes negotiated maximum fair prices for selected Part D drugs under the Inflation Reduction Act.

title: Blocking property and prohibiting new investment in the Russian Federation
abstract: OFAC expands sanctions on Russia, prohibiting new investment and certain services by U.S. persons.

title: Regulatory capital rule: large banking organizations (Basel III endgame)
abstract: The Federal Reserve, FDIC and OCC propose revised capital requirements for banks with $100 billion or more in assets.

title: Multi-pollutant emissions standards for light-duty and medium-duty vehicles
abstract: EPA sets stricter greenhouse gas and pollutant standards for model year 2027 and later vehicles.

title: Credit card penalty fees (Regulation Z)
abstract: The CFPB lowers the safe-harbor amount large card issuers may charge for late payments.

title: Debit card interchange fees and routing (Regulation II)
abstract: The Federal Reserve proposes to lower the cap on interchange fees for debit transactions at large issuers.

title: Safeguarding and securing the open internet (net neutrality)
abstract: The FCC reclassifies broadband internet access service as a telecommunications service under Title II.

title: Section 232 investigation of imports of pharmaceuticals and pharmaceutical ingredients
abstract: Commerce opens a national security investigation that may lead to tariffs on imported drugs and ingredients.

title: Medicare Advantage capitation rates and Part C and Part D payment policies
abstract: CMS announces payment rates and risk adjustment changes for Medicare Advantage plans.

title: National outer continental shelf oil and gas leasing program
abstract: The Interior Department sets the schedule of offshore oil and gas lease sales.

title: Imposing duties to address the flow of illicit drugs across the northern and southern borders
abstract: Executive order imposing tariffs on imports from Canada and Mexico under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.

title: Restriction on entry of certain nonimmigrant workers (H-1B)
abstract: Proclamation adding a fee and new conditions for H-1B specialty occupation visa petitions.

title: Federal Acquisition Regulation: cybersecurity requirements for defense contractors (CMMC)
abstract: The Department of Defense requires contractors to meet cybersecurity maturity certification levels to win contracts.

title: Global minimum tax: treatment of foreign taxes under Pillar Two
abstract: Treasury and IRS guidance on how the 15 percent global minimum tax interacts with U.S. foreign tax credits.

title: Regulating imports with a reciprocal tariff to rectify trade practices
abstract: Executive order imposing a baseline 10 percent tariff on imports from all trading partners and higher country-specific reciprocal tariffs.

title: Adjusting imports of automobiles and automobile parts into the United States
abstract: Proclamation under Section 232 imposing a 25 percent tariff on imported passenger vehicles, light trucks and key parts.

title: Notice of request for public comments on Section 232 national security investigation of imports of semiconductors and semiconductor manufacturing equipment
abstract: Commerce opens a Section 232 investigation into imported semiconductors, chip-making equipment and derivative products.

title: Adjusting imports of timber, lumber and their derivative products into the United States
abstract: Proclamation imposing Section 232 tariffs on softwood lumber, kitchen cabinets, vanities and upholstered furniture.

title: Delivering most-favored-nation prescription drug pricing to American patients
abstract: Executive order directing agencies to seek prices for U.S. drugs in line with the lowest prices paid in other developed countries.

title: Framework for artificial intelligence diffusion
abstract: The Bureau of Industry and Security sets worldwide license requirements and country tiers for advanced AI chips and closed model weights.

title: Expansion of end-user controls to cover affiliates of certain listed entities
abstract: BIS extends Entity List and Military End-User restrictions to companies 50 percent or more owned by listed parties.

title: Section 45Y clean electricity production credit and section 48E clean electricity investment credit
abstract: Treasury final regulations on the technology-neutral clean electricity tax credits created by the Inflation Reduction Act.

title: Temporary withdrawal of all areas on the outer continental shelf from offshore wind leasing
abstract: Presidential memorandum withdrawing offshore areas from wind leasing and pausing federal wind permits.

title: Overdraft lending: very large financial institutions
abstract: CFPB rule treating overdraft fees at large banks as credit unless priced at or below cost or a 5 dollar benchmark.

title: Regulatory capital rule: modifications to the enhanced supplementary leverage ratio standards
abstract: Fed, OCC and FDIC propose recalibrating the enhanced supplementary leverage ratio for the largest bank holding companies.

title: The enhancement and standardization of climate-related disclosures for investors
abstract: SEC rule requiring registrants to disclose material climate-related risks and, for larger filers, greenhouse gas emissions.

title: Defining and delimiting the exemptions for executive, administrative and professional employees
abstract: Department of Labor rule raising the salary threshold for overtime exemption.

title: Notice of request for public comments on Section 232 national security investigation of imports of processed critical minerals and derivative products
abstract: Commerce investigates dependence on imported processed critical minerals, including rare earths.

title: Securing the information and communications technology and services supply chain: connected vehicles
abstract: BIS bars connected-vehicle software and hardware linked to China or Russia from vehicles sold in the United States.

title: Imposing sanctions on Rosneft and Lukoil
abstract: OFAC designates Russia's two largest oil companies and their subsidiaries.

title: PFAS national primary drinking water regulation
abstract: EPA sets enforceable limits for six PFAS chemicals in drinking water.

title: Repeal of greenhouse gas emissions standards for fossil fuel-fired electric generating units
abstract: EPA proposes repealing carbon dioxide standards for coal and gas power plants.

title: Lowering drug prices by once again putting Americans first
abstract: Executive order on drug pricing, including Medicare negotiation changes and pharmacy benefit manager transparency.

title: Ending illegal discrimination and restoring merit-based opportunity
abstract: Executive order revoking affirmative action requirements for federal contractors and directing agencies to target private DEI programs.

title: Defining larger participants of a market for general-use digital consumer payment applications
abstract: CFPB brings large payment app providers under its supervision.

title: Safeguarding American food: revoking authorization of FD&C Red No. 3
abstract: FDA revokes approval of the color additive Red No. 3 in food and ingested drugs.

title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program waivers restricting purchases of soda and candy
abstract: USDA approves state waivers removing soft drinks and candy from SNAP-eligible purchases.

title: Provisions pertaining to U.S. investments in certain national security technologies and products in countries of concern
abstract: Treasury rule restricting and requiring notice of U.S. investments in Chinese semiconductors, quantum computing and AI.

title: Unlocking America's offshore energy and liquefied natural gas exports
abstract: DOE lifts the pause on new approvals of LNG exports to countries without free trade agreements.

title: Medicare program: CY 2026 physician fee schedule and site-neutral payment changes
abstract: CMS updates Medicare payments to physicians and hospital outpatient departments.

title: Rescission of the 2009 endangerment finding and motor vehicle greenhouse gas emission standards
abstract: EPA proposes rescinding the finding that greenhouse gases endanger public health, and the vehicle GHG standards that rest on it.

title: Corporate average fuel economy standards reset
abstract: NHTSA proposes rolling back fuel economy standards for model years 2022 to 2031.
